page.overview:
Who is Spinel?

Spinel is the overarching main antagonist of . He is a former scientist who worked for Exceed, who secretly worked with the Explorers as one of the organization's admins. He later replaced Gibeon as leader of the Explorers in a desperate gambit to get rid of Amethio, as well as becoming the now-former president of Exceed.

Spinel has teal hair with fluffy strands that extend down to his shoulders, with a dark teal tint near the end of his bangs. His eyes are narrow and two-toned, between soft pink and sky blue. His outfit is of a dark blue side-cape with a silver-and-blue gem clip, a black bodysuit, and a light teal coat and boots with yellow buttons and black accents.

During the one-year timeskip, Spinel has shortened his hair and adorned it with a blue gem, forming a ponytail. His coat and cape have become more partially dark blue, with their accents becoming more light yellow. He also wears an additional blue necktie.

As a child, Spinel had shorter hair, and wore glasses. His attire consisted of a pale blue long-sleeved shirt, a black belt, grey trousers, and dark brown shoes.
